description: Get a recording's full transcript: timestamped segments plus the flattened plaintext. If it isn't ready yet, returns the current status so you can poll (or call wait_for_artifacts).

id.description: The recording's public id (the slug in its share URL, e.g. 'a1b2c3d4e5f6') or the full https://clipy.online/video/<id> URL.

name: get_transcript
